AK-WHO-H2: Who the Authority Kit is for
AK-WHO-BODY: Brands that already have a product and a site but keep losing the search to competitors. Think an established UK skincare brand in a crowded category, or a clinic with real expertise and no pages that prove it. If your brand is sorted but you're invisible in search and AI answers, start here.
AK-INC-A: The Authority Kit combines three pieces in one plan. First, clear positioning and a site structure search engines can follow. Then SEO/AEO/GEO work, so you're easier to find in search and to name in AI answers. Finally, a content engine that keeps publishing useful pages around the questions your buyers actually ask.
AK-INC-1-BODY: What you should be known for, mapped into a site with clear sections, descriptive URLs and pages that each do one job.
AK-INC-2-BODY: Technical fixes, on-page SEO and answer-ready content, written to help search engines and AI tools understand and mention your brand.
AK-INC-3-BODY: Our content team plans and writes long-form pages from the questions your buyers really ask, each linked back to the pages that sell. A person edits every piece and you approve it before it goes live. Four pieces a month by default, with the pace agreed at onboarding.
AK-TOPIC-H2: What "authority" means to search engines and AI answers
AK-TOPIC-A: Topical authority is the idea that a site which covers a subject thoroughly and consistently is more likely to be trusted for it. In practice that means a clear pillar page, supporting articles that answer related questions, sensible internal links between them and facts about your brand that match everywhere.
AK-STRUCT-A: Keep it shallow and logical. Every important page should be reachable in a few clicks, grouped under clear sections such as services, kits and guides, with descriptive URLs and links between related pages. Each page should target one main topic, so search engines and AI tools understand what it's for.
AK-ENGINE-A: A content engine is a steady, planned rhythm of useful pages, not one-off blog posts. It starts from the questions buyers ask, turns them into a calendar of guides and answers and links each piece back to the pages that sell. AI speeds up the research and the drafts. People make the calls.
AK-EXPECT-A: Longer than ads, because authority builds as search engines recrawl your site and learn to trust it. We won't promise rankings, AI mentions or dates. What you get instead is an agreed plan with checkpoints, plain-English reporting on what's moving and a clear say in what we tackle next.
AK-ALT-H2: Authority Kit or SEO/AEO/GEO on its own?
AK-ALT-BODY: Brand sorted and you just need to be found? Take SEO/AEO/GEO on its own. Pick the kit when the problem runs deeper: a fuzzy message, a site that grew without a plan or no time to keep publishing. Live on nearby customers? The Local Domination Kit is built for that.
AK-FAQ-1-A: Three pieces in one plan: positioning and site structure, SEO/AEO/GEO and a content engine. Together they make your brand easier for search engines and AI tools to understand, with pages that answer the questions your buyers actually ask. The fit call is where we work out what to tackle first.
AK-FAQ-2-Q: How long until the Authority Kit works?
AK-FAQ-2-A: Longer than ads, and anyone promising overnight rankings is guessing. Technical fixes can happen early, but rankings and AI mentions build as search engines recrawl your site and learn to trust your content. We agree a scoped plan with checkpoints at the start, then show you what's moving at each one.
AK-FAQ-3-Q: Can you guarantee a top ranking or an AI mention?
AK-FAQ-3-A: No, and you should be wary of anyone who does. Nobody controls Google's results or what AI assistants say. What we can do is fix what's holding your site back, build pages around real buyer questions and make your brand clear enough that search engines and AI tools have good reason to show it.
AK-FAQ-4-Q: Do I need the whole kit or just SEO/AEO/GEO?
AK-FAQ-4-A: Not always the whole kit. Take SEO/AEO/GEO on its own if your brand is sorted and you need to be found. The kit adds positioning, site structure and a content engine, which helps when your message is fuzzy or your site has grown without a plan. We'll recommend one honestly at the fit call.
AK-FAQ-5-A: Our content team writes it. AI speeds up the research and the drafts. People make the calls. A person edits every piece and you approve it before it goes live. The default is four long-form pieces a month, with the exact pace agreed at onboarding. We promise useful pages, not rankings.
AK-FAQ-6-Q: Can you do this for Australia, Canada or Singapore?
AK-FAQ-6-A: Yes. We work with SMBs across the UK, Australia, Canada and Singapore. Search behaves differently in each. Spelling, local terms, competitors and even the questions people ask AI tools can change by market. So we research each market you sell in rather than copying a UK plan across.
